units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 89b">B. Mets. 89ᵇ</cite> (Ar. <cite ref="C00166"><he>גדד</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 36b">B. Bath. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיגדור ג׳ גדירות</he> until he has reaped three date harvests.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:6">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᶜ</cite> top; Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 73b">Sabb. 73ᵇ</cite> (terms equivalent to <cite ref="S00543"><he>קוצר</he></cite>); Y. ib. 10ᵃ ed. Krot. <he>הגורד</he> (corr. acc.).—

<cite ref="Shabbat 50a">Sabb. 50ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 125b:11">125ᵇ</cite> <he>חריות … שגְּדָרָן לעצים</he> twigs of a date tree which one cut with the intention of using them for fuel; v. <cite ref="C00235"><he>גָּדַע</he></cite>.—
Tosef. Ber. IV, 21; a. fr.—*Part. pass. גָּדוּר cut down.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:13">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 13</cite> <he>כרם ג׳ בציפורי</he> (Var. <he>גדול</he>; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 6:4">Shebi. VI, 4</cite> <he>גריד</he>) a ruined vineyard in Zepphoris.

senses.gloss: to surround with a גֶּדֶר, fence in; to limit, control, ward off.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 23a:3">B. Kam. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>שהיה לו לגוֹדְרָהּ ולא גְדָרָהּ</he> he ought to have fenced it in and did not do so.
<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:7">Tosef. M. Kat. I, 7</cite> <he>חומת … גּוֹדְרִין אותה</he> if a city wall is broken into, we may fence it in (repair it, during the festive week).—
Gen. R. s. 49 (play on haaf, Gen. XVIII, 23) אתה גוֹדֵר את האף והאף לא יִגְדָּרְךָ Thou controllest the anger, but the anger does not control Thee.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:17">Y. Ber. IX, end, 14ᶜ</cite> <he>וגוֹדְרָהּ</he>, v. <cite ref="G00642"><he>זָקֵן</he> I</cite>.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:6">Mikv. V, 6</cite> <he>גודר כלים</he> one may form a dam with garments (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 4:10">Tosef. ib. IV, 10</cite> <cite ref="C01392"><he>גרר</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:4:9">Y. Ber. III, 6ᶜ</cite> <he>דבר שהוא גוֹדֵר את ישראל מן וכ׳</he> a custom which guards Israel from sin.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:6">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> <he>מי שהוא גודר עצמו וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 2:4:3">Y. Yeb. II, 3ᵈ</cite> top <he>פורש</he>) he who guards himself against sin (restraining himself from anything unchaste) is called holy.
Gen. R. s. 70 גָּדְרוּ עצמן וכ׳ trained themselves to chastity; a. fr.—Part. pass. גָּדוּר abstinent, chaste.

Lev. R. s. 22 ומעצמו הוא ג׳ and he will become abstinent of his own accord. Gen. R. l. c. אנשי מזרח גְּדוּרִים וכ׳ the people of the East are chaste; a. fr.—ג׳ פרצה (or sub. פרצה) to fence in a breach, to remedy calamities, also to check lawlessness by preventive measures (v. גְּזֵרָה).
<cite ref="Berakhot 19a:19">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>שתִּגְדּוֹר וכ׳</he> that Thou repair our breaches (relieve us); <cite ref="Bava Batra 91b">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite>.—
Lev. R. s. 1 (play on Abigdor I Chr. IV, 4) הרבה גוֹדְרִין וכ׳ Israel had many fencemakers (guardians against sin). Ruth. R. s. 2, a. fr.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 6a:4">Erub. 6ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ג׳ בה גדר</he>, v. <cite ref="B01131"><he>בִּקְעָה</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 10:8:4">Y. Erub. X, 26ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דלת גודרת וכ׳</he>; Tosef. ib. XI (VII), 18 <he>גוררת</he> ed. Zuck., Var. <he>גוד׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C01392"><he>גָּרַר</he></cite>.]—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 15:3:3">Y. Sabb. XV, 15ᵇ</cite> top <he>וגדרתא</he>, read <he>וּגְדָרַתָּהּ</he>.]

senses.gloss: to be guarded; to guard one’s self. Y. Sabb. XVII, beg. 16ᵃ כיון שנִגְדְּרוּ (ib. III, 6ᵃ top שנִתְגַּדְּרוּ) when they had been trained (to guard against desecrating the Sabbath).
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32">Lev. R. s. 32</cite> <he>נ׳ כל הנשים וכ׳</he> all women were made chaste through her meritorious example; a. e.

<cite ref="Gittin 56b">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:5">Lev. R. s. 20</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22">22</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:21">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>וגִידּ׳ את הפרוכת</he> and cut into the curtain (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite>; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 1 <he>וגָד׳</he>). [<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:20">Tosef. Shebi. III, 20</cite> <he>מְגַדֵּר בחורשין</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <he>מברך</he>) to cut into, to clear thickets, v. <he>בהה</he>.]

senses.gloss: [ [to cut one’sself off from others,] to distinguish one’s self, to excel; to raise one’s self above others, to arrogate power, be presumptuous.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 17a:8">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>כשם שהוא אינו מִתְגַּדֵּר וכ׳</he> as he cannot excel in my work (study), so can I not in his (field labor).

<cite ref="Chullin 7a">Ḥull. 7ᵃ</cite> my predecessors have left room for me <he>להִתְגַּדֵּר בו</he> to distinguish myself; <cite ref="Yoma 78a">Yoma 78ᵃ</cite>; (Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ bot. <he>עטרה להתעטר</he>, Ar. <he>להתגדר</he>).—

<cite ref="Nedarim 81a:3">Ned. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שלא יִתְגַּדְּרוּ על וכ׳</he> in order that they may not be presumptuous towards the people; v. <cite ref="C00128"><he>גָּבַר</he></cite> Hithpa. [Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa 1 <he>כבן שמתגדר וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C01394"><he>גָּרַר</he> II</cite>.]
